verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since monday.com ships AI features and passes data to model providers, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for model training or offers an opt-out. The nearest statements, "data never leaves our secure servers" for app hosting infrastructure and "keep data secure with trusted AI connectors," are general security claims, not training-use controls.
